reasoning: Provider record 299d6bfe-da13-4491-bc28-481f1f2aa54c (stock_and_cash_mergers, event date 2021-07-21) names acquirer CRM (CUSIP 79466L302) and acquiree WORK (CUSIP 83088V102); it is identical in both data_quality payloads. The primary SEC filing (URL, retrieval time and SHA-256 in evidence) states: "On July 21, 2021 (the "Closing Date") the Company completed the acquisition of Slack Technologies, Inc." and "On the Closing Date, pursuant to the Merger Agreement, and upon the terms and subject to the conditions therein, Merger Sub I merged with and into Slack (the "First Merger"), with Slack surviving the First Merger and continuing as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.". The filing therefore documents that Slack Technologies, Inc. became a wholly owned subsidiary of Salesforce (salesforce.com, inc.) on 2021-07-21, consistent with the provider record placing CRM as the acquiring issuer of this merger record. Decision SAME_ENTITY: the record belongs to the Stage R entity CRM (as acquirer). Economic neutrality was not used as identity evidence. Under v2.0.3 item 5 the record is then processed as the entity's frozen §3.4 review item (acquirer-side merger).
